note: Mix It Up (Stage 2 review: no-carry addition and no-borrow subtraction, 11-19). English only. Teaching has no dangling question: scene one compares add vs take away, scene two turns ten-and-six into the number sixteen. Answer phase is pure tap: add, take away, and read-the-picture. No self-answer in the answer phase.

lines.text: Let's review! When we add, we put blocks together.
When we take away, we remove blocks.
Remember, always look at the ones first!
One ten and six ones make sixteen.
Let's see if you remember everything! Let's play!
Thirteen plus four. Tap the answer.
Twelve plus six. Tap the answer.
Fourteen plus two. Tap the answer.
Eleven plus eight. Tap the answer.
Seventeen minus five. Tap the answer.
Nineteen minus four. Tap the answer.
Sixteen minus three. Tap the answer.
Eighteen minus four. Tap the answer.
Look at the picture. Which number is it?
